quiz.question: Under the Mental Healthcare Act 2017, what is the legal status of a suicide attempt in India?
options: It remains a punishable criminal offense under the IPC
It is punishable only if the person refuses free government treatment
It requires mandatory court-ordered admission under Section 89
quiz.explanation: According to the Mental Healthcare Act 2017, a suicide attempt is specifically decriminalized under Section 115. Additionally, the act provides for free treatment at government mental health facilities.
